property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner and any fuzzed address newOwner, after calling transferOwnership(newOwner) on the correct contract either the call reverts or the owner() getter returns newOwner but never address(0); the mutant allows a successful call that leaves owner() == address(0).
change_summary: Removed the guard that prevents transferring ownership to the zero address by deleting the require check, allowing transferOwnership(address(0)) to set owner to zero.
